architect-cto/workflow:reflection-describe-a-flag-by-its-stored-predicate#A derived flag is described by the predicate it stores, the stamp is the fact, never by the state of the world the author assumes it implies: merge_target 'When a contract sentence about behaviour keeps missing a reachable state' names no section of architect-cto/workflow; written as its own topic

architect-cto/workflow:reflection-linux-desktops-also-break-filesystem-rules-drafted-under-umask-022#Filesystem rules drafted on a umask-022 host also break on ordinary Linux desktops: user-private-group accounts run umask 002 so a group of one shows a group-write bit, with a POSIX access ACL the group mode bits are the ACL mask, and the owner means the effective uid; run the suites under umask 002 before ruling: merge_target 'read an every binding rule against each mobile platform' names no section of architect-cto/workflow; written as its own topic
